D018-D002_h001.question:

I teach piano, so I need to focus, stay present with my students, but I keep losing track of where I am in a piece or forgetting who had which assignment. It’s not just me, though. That day, the safety check was signed off by the foreman—guy knew the harness was old. He pushed us to cut corners. Still works here, same as ever. Feels wrong that no one’s really paying for that.  

But focus? Yeah, it’s been off. I’ll start on a repair and lose the thread, forget where I put the tools. Happens more now, but I can’t say when it really started. School wasn’t easy, but I don’t know—was it this bad back then? Can’t pin it down.
